advocate.argument: This is not just a party gathering story — it's the biggest split in Nepal's oldest democratic party playing out in public. Gagan Thapa's establishment faction is holding the 15th General Convention at Tundikhel with ~10,000 delegates/well-wishers, while former PM and ex-NC president Sher Bahadur Deuba is boycotting, calling the process 'illegal,' and has filed a rival convention schedule (Dec 7-9) with the Election Commission.
